definitions.explanation: The beginning of a new calendar year, especially the first few days of January. A very important holiday period in Japan.

examples.japanese: {新年|しんねん}⟦{明|あ}けまして→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧。
{新年|しんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
{新年|しんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{抱負|ほうふ}→抱負：18473_houfu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧。
examples.english: To talk about New Year's resolutions.

notes:
{新年|しんねん} refers to the New Year, one of the most important holidays in Japan.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {新年|しんねん}⟦{明|あ}けまして→明ける：21288_akeru⟧⟦おめでとう→おめでとう：01043_omedetou⟧⟦ございます→ございます：01300_gozaimasu⟧: Happy New Year (formal greeting)
- {新年|しんねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}える→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧: to welcome the New Year
- {新年|しんねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{挨拶|あいさつ}→挨拶：02505_aisatsu⟧: New Year's greetings
- ⟦{新年会|しんねんかい}→新年会：20392_shinnenkai⟧: New Year's party

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧: New Year (especially Jan 1-3)
- ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧: New Year's card
- ⟦{初詣|はつもうで}→初詣：05804_hatsumoude⟧: first shrine visit of the year

NOTE: Do not confuse with ⟦{信念|しんねん}→信念：03074_shinnen⟧ (conviction, belief), which has the same reading.
